heading: State reentry project evaluation

tree.heading: Evaluation
tree.text: The Attorney General shall evaluate the demonstration projects authorized by section 10631 of this title to determine their effectiveness.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Not later than April 30, 2005, the Attorney General shall submit a report to the Committees on the Judiciary of the House of Representatives and the Senate containing—

children.text: the findings of the evaluation required by subsection (a); and
any recommendations the Attorney General has with regard to expanding, changing, or eliminating the demonstration projects.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 3797w–1 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
